x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
t1 = x / y
min_diff = 1e15
best_a = 0
best_b = 1
t = 1 + t1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    val1 = int(t1 * i) / i
    diff1 = abs(val1 - t1)
    if not (diff1 > t - 1e-15 and diff1 < t + 1e-15):
        if diff1 < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff1
            best_a = int(t1 * i)
            best_b = i

    val2 = (int(t1 * i) + 1) / i
    diff2 = abs(val2 - t1)
    if not (diff2 > t - 1e-15 and diff2 < t + 1e-15):
        if diff2 < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff2
            best_a = int(t1 * i) + 1
            best_b = i

print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")
